title: Stop thinking and start doing ｜ 停止空想，开始行动

sents.en: Most people have a dream in life, a vision of who or what they'd like to be in the future.
sents.cn: 大多数人心中都有人生的梦想，一种对未来想成为何种人或成就何事的愿景。

sents.en: At a minimum, everyone has interests and values that determine what they want out of their lives.
sents.cn: 至少，每个人都有决定自己想从生活中得到什么的兴趣与价值观。

sents.en: Even so, trying to set achievable goals that you'll work for over the course of many years can be extremely challenging.
sents.cn: 即便如此，试图设定一个你将为之奋斗多年的可达目标，也可能极具挑战。

sents.en: It can be hard to know where to even begin, and the things you hope to achieve may seem impossible.
sents.cn: 很难知道该从何着手，而你希望达成的东西似乎遥不可及。

sents.en: But if you're well prepared you may be able to set goals for your life that are just as fulfilling to work toward as to achieve.
sents.cn: 但如果你准备充分，或许就能为自己设定一些在追求过程中与达成时同样令人满足的人生目标。

sents.en: We all have goals that we want to achieve in our lives.
sents.cn: 我们都有想在人生中达成的目标。

sents.en: These goals may include learning a new language, eating healthier and losing weight becoming a better parent, saving more money, and so on.
sents.cn: 这些目标可能包括学习一门新语言、吃得更健康、减减肥、做个更好的家长、多存点钱，等等。

sents.en: It can be easy to assume that the gap between where you are now and where you want to be in the future is caused by a lack of knowledge.
sents.cn: 人们很容易以为，自己当下所处位置与未来想去之处之间的差距，是由知识匮乏造成的。

sents.en: This is why we buy courses on how to start a business or how to lose weight fast or how to learn a new language in three months.
sents.cn: 这就是为什么我们会购买关于如何创业、如何快速减肥、或如何在三个月内学会一门新语言的课程。

sents.en: We assume that if we knew about a better strategy, then we would get better results.
sents.cn: 我们假定，如果知道更好的策略，就能得到更好的结果。

sents.en: We believe that a new result requires new knowledge.
sents.cn: 我们相信，新的结果需要新的知识。

sents.en: What I'm starting to realize, however, is that new knowledge does not necessarily drive new results.
sents.cn: 然而，我逐渐意识到，新的知识并不必然带来新的结果。

sents.en: In fact, learning something new can actually be a waste of time if your goal is to make progress and not simply gain additional knowledge.
sents.cn: 事实上，如果你的目标是取得进步、而非仅仅获取额外知识，那么学习新东西实际上可能是在浪费时间。

sents.en: It all comes down to the difference between learning and practicing.
sents.cn: 一切都归结为学习与实践之间的差别。

sents.en: Thomas Sterner, in his book The Practicing Mind, explains the key difference between practicing and learning.
sents.cn: 托马斯∙斯特纳在其著作《练习的心态》中，解释了实践与学习的关键区别。

sents.en: He says: "When we practice something, we are involved in the deliberate repetition of a process with the intention of reaching a specific goal." Here the words "deliberate" and "intention" are key, because they define the difference between actively practicing something and passively learning it.
sents.cn: 他说："当我们实践某事时，我们是带着达成特定目标的意图，刻意重复一个过程。"这里的"刻意"和"意图"二词是关键，因为它们界定了主动实践某事与被动学习它的差异。

sents.en: Learning something new and practicing something new may seem very similar but these two methods can have profoundly different results.
sents.cn: 学习新东西与实践新东西看似非常相似，但这两种方法可能产生截然不同的结果。

sents.en: Here are some additional ways to think about the difference.
sents.cn: 这里有一些额外的思考方式来看待这种区别。

sents.en: Let's say your goal is to get stronger and more fit.
sents.cn: 假设你的目标是变得更强健、更匀称。

sents.en: You can research the best instructions on weight lifting technique, but the only way to build strength is to practice lifting weights.
sents.cn: 你可以研究举重技巧的最佳指导，但增强力量的唯一途径是练习举重。

sents.en: Let's say your goal is to grow your startup.
sents.cn: 假设你的目标是发展你的初创企业。

sents.en: You can learn about the best way to make a sales pitch, but the only way to actually land customers is to practice making sales calls.
sents.cn: 你可以学习做销售推介的最佳方式，但真正赢得客户的唯一途径是练习打销售电话。

sents.en: Let's say your goal is to write a book.
sents.cn: 假设你的目标是写一本书。

sents.en: You can talk to a best-selling author about writing, but the only way to become a better writer is to practice publishing consistently.
sents.cn: 你可以与畅销书作者谈论写作，但成为更优秀作家的唯一途径是坚持练习发表作品。

sents.en: Passive learning creates knowledge.
sents.cn: 被动学习产生知识。

sents.en: Active practice creates skill.
sents.cn: 主动实践产生技能。

sents.en: Let's consider a couple more reasons to prioritize active practice over passive learning.
sents.cn: 让我们再考虑几个优先主动实践而非被动学习的理由。

sents.en: First, passive learning can be a stick that supports inaction.
sents.cn: 首先，被动学习可能成为支撑不作为的一根拐杖。

sents.en: In many cases, learning is actually a way to avoid taking action on the goals and interests that we say are important to us.
sents.cn: 在许多情况下，学习实际上是一种逃避对我们声称重要的目标与兴趣采取行动的方式。

sents.en: For example, let's say you want to learn a foreign language.
sents.cn: 例如，假设你想学习一门外语。

sents.en: Reading a book on how to learn a foreign language quickly allows you to feel like you are making progress ("Hey, I'm figuring out the best way to do this!").
sents.cn: 读一本关于如何快速学习外语的书，会让你感觉自己在取得进展（"嘿，我正在找出最佳方法！

sents.en: Of course, you're not actually practicing the action that would deliver your desired outcome (speaking the foreign language).
sents.cn: "）。当然，你并没有真正在练习能带来理想结果（说这门外语）的行动。

sents.en: In situations like this one, we often claim that we are preparing or researching the best method, but these rationalizations allow us to feel like we are moving forward when we are merely spinning our wheels.
sents.cn: 在这样的情形下，我们常声称自己是在准备或研究最佳方法，但这些合理化说辞让我们在只是原地打转时，却感觉自己在向前迈进。

sents.en: We make the mistake of being in motion rather than taking action.
sents.cn: 我们犯了"处于运动中"而非"采取行动"的错误。

sents.en: Learning is valuable until it becomes a form of procrastination (拖延).
sents.cn: 学习是有价值的，直到它变成一种拖延（拖延）的形式。

sents.en: Another point to consider is that practice is learning, but learning is not practice.
sents.cn: 另一个要考虑的要点是：实践是学习，但学习不是实践。

sents.en: Passive learning is not a form of practice because although you gain new knowledge, you are not discovering how to apply that knowledge.
sents.cn: 被动学习不是实践的一种形式，因为尽管你获得了新知识，却并未发现如何运用它。

sents.en: Active practice, meanwhile, is one of the greatest forms of learning because the mistakes you make while practicing reveal important insights.
sents.cn: 与此同时，主动实践是最佳学习形式之一，因为你在实践中所犯的错误会揭示重要的洞见。

sents.en: Even more importantly, practice is the only way to make a meaningful contribution with your knowledge.
sents.cn: 更重要的是，实践是用你的知识做出有意义贡献的唯一途径。

sents.en: You can watch an online course about how to build a business or read an article about a terrible disaster in a developing nation, but that knowledge is unproductive unless you actually launch your business or donate to those in need.
sents.cn: 你可以观看关于如何创业的网络课程，或阅读一篇关于某发展中国家严重灾难的文章，但除非你真正启动自己的事业或向有需要的人捐款，否则这些知识毫无产出。

sents.en: Learning by itself can be valuable for you but if you want to be valuable to others, then you have to express your knowledge in some way.
sents.cn: 学习本身对你而言可能很有价值，但如果你想对他人有价值，就必须以某种方式表达你的知识。

sents.en: The last important point to consider is that practice focuses your energy on the process.
sents.cn: 最后一个要考虑的要点是，实践将你的精力聚焦于过程。

sents.en: Thomas Sterner once said, "Progress is a natural result of staying focused on the process of doing anything." The state of your life right now is a result of the habits and beliefs that you have been practicing each day, When you realize this and begin to direct your focus toward practicing better habits day-in and day-out, continual progress will be the logical outcome.
sents.cn: 托马斯∙斯特纳曾说："进步是专注于做任何事之过程的自然结果。"你当下生活的状态，是日复一日所实践的习性与信念的结果；当你意识到这一点，并开始将注意力导向日复一日地实践更好的习惯，持续的进步便是合乎逻辑的结果。

sents.en: It is not the things we learn nor the dreams we visualize that determine our results, but rather the habits that we practice each day.
sents.cn: 决定我们结果的，不是所学之物，也不是所设想的梦想，而是我们每天所实践的习惯。

sents.en: Fall in love with boredom and focus your energy on the process, not the product.
sents.cn: 爱上枯燥，将精力聚焦于过程，而非产物。

sents.en: What does this all mean?
sents.cn: 这一切意味着什么？

sents.en: Is passive learning useless?
sents.cn: 被动学习一无是处吗？

sents.en: Of course not.
sents.cn: 当然不是。

sents.en: In many cases, learning for the sake of learning can be a beautiful thing.
sents.cn: 在许多情况下，为学习而学习可以是一件美好的事。

sents.en: Not to mention that soaking up new information can help you make more informed decisions when you do decide to take action.
sents.cn: 更不用说，吸收新信息能帮助你在决定采取行动时做出更明智的决策。

sents.en: That said, the main point of this article is that learning by itself does not lead to progress.
sents.cn: 话虽如此，本文的要旨是：学习本身并不会带来进步。

sents.en: We often hide behind information and use learning as an excuse to delay the more difficult and more important choice of actually doing something.
sents.cn: 我们常躲在信息背后，把学习当作借口，来推迟那个更困难也更重要的、真正去做的选择。

sents.en: Spend less time passively learning and more time actively practicing.
sents.cn: 少花些时间被动学习，多花些时间主动实践。

sents.en: Stop thinking and start doing.
sents.cn: 停止空想，开始行动。
